node_definition.done_when: Done when tests/test_an_abandoned_launch_retires_no_newer_records.py builds a run on a temporary crew home and repository. Its newer attempt has written its attempt, worker and exit records, but no worker is live. The test drives a superseded fresh dispatch of the older attempt, and asserts that the newer attempt's records are byte-identical afterwards and that no supervisor starts. A second case, a fresh dispatch whose attempt is still the newest, prepares its records and starts its supervisor as before. Negative control: at the base revision the first case leaves the newer attempt's records overwritten or unlinked. The test files importing reckon.crew.dispatching.launch or reckon.crew.dispatch_launch add no failure against base in matched arms run as an all_debug partition job, submitted with env -u SLURM_JOB_ID -u SLURM_JOBID sbatch and never on the fleet node. Each arm's log sits under the run directory, opens with its revision and literal command, and ends in EXIT= . ruff check and ruff format --check add no finding on the staged paths.
